description: Source code for a Windows-specific audio decoder implementation within the Starboard platform, handling AAC, AC3, and EAC3 codecs, including buffer management, decoding, and thread safety.

classes.name: AbstractWin32AudioDecoderImpl
classes.description: Windows-specific implementation of an audio decoder handling AAC, AC3, and EAC3 codecs with buffer processing, thread safety, and end-of-stream handling.

methods.name: Consume
methods.description: Processes an input sample, extracts audio data, detects AAC headers, and queues decoded audio.

methods.name: TryWrite
methods.description: Attempts to write an input buffer to the decoder, adjusting for AAC ADTS headers if necessary.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream, processes remaining samples, and updates internal state.

methods.name: ProcessAndRead
methods.description: Retrieves decoded audio data if available.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and thread checker.

methods.name: GetSamplesPerSecond
methods.description: Returns the sample rate, doubling it if AAC HE-AAC is detected.
